Owner-requested codification of the accepted Fray75/712 architecture is committed as docs/adr/0022-mapping-producers-and-evidence.md at 4eb625970205e1f62b300ca897e94eaa927bbd6c (standalone clone .worktrees/recall-timing-portable). ADR direction is accepted; exact-wording peer review is pending in Fray82. No implementation or gate completion follows.

Implementation acceptance crosswalk: MP1 lawful categorical success without fabricated HsmmResult/numeric DecisionBasis; MP2 checked packet/selection/rendering bindings and asserted-versus-executed provenance; MP4 shortlist-limited unresolved versus true external plus top-k accounting; MP5 run/attempt/stratum denominators, abstention and failure; MP6 chronology exposure does not self-certify reference; MP8 identical producer/reader/view semantics. MP3 is jointly owned with source/video coverage and MP7 with existing temporal/localization work. The ADR gives concrete discriminating witnesses and existing ticket IDs; these are specifications to execute with their implementing slices, not tests already run or added 1.0 blockers. Preserve the current facade reference+reconstruction obligation and existing release priorities. Lead+codex-temporal own the concrete result/facade extension proposal; no new parallel roadmap or ticket is created.

Documentation checks: five relative links resolve, MP1-MP8 present, git diff --check passes. Lead owns integration and PLAN pointer; existing producer/temporal/Atlas implementation tickets remain open.
